verdicts.reason: Both break the core SALE motif. The red letters are pulled out of their white circles, which are left empty in a tiny column, and S/A/L/E are scattered across the banner between shrunken decoration clusters that are too small to read. The L is also much smaller than the other letters. A keeps the letters spaced apart in reading order, though 'NEW YEAR SPECIAL' sits too close to the left edge. B crams the tiny L into the E and against a decoration cluster, which makes it slightly worse.
